fair adjective

of the weather: clear, bright

also clear (weather), fine (weather), bright (weather), good (weather), fine weather, cloudless, nice weather

classical

Enn. ap. Cic. Div. 2.39.82: tempestāte serēnā (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 133, 135
Traupman 312
Traupman 315

serēnus, serēna, serēnum

declension

clear, fair, bright

Other words

  • sūdus, sūda, sūdum — cloudless, bright and dry

    declension · also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. sūdus; Traupman 135; Traupman 312

  • serēnitās, serēnitātis f. — fine weather

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Div. 2.45.94 (Lewis & Short: “clear, fair, or serene weather”); Traupman 135; Traupman 315
